hooks.command:
input=$(cat)
p=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.path // ""')
c=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
case "$(basename "$p")" in
  .env.example) exit 0 ;;
  .env|.env.*)
    [ "$c" = view ] && exit 0
    echo '{"decision":"deny","reason":"No se permiten .env: la config se lee de Vault."}'
    exit 2 ;;
esac
exit 0

cd "$OPENHANDS_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0
for t in ruff jq; do
  command -v "$t" >/dev/null || {
    echo "{\"decision\":\"deny\",\"reason\":\"Falta $t en la imagen.\"}"
    exit 2
  }
done
fail=
bad=$(ruff check --config /opt/baseline/ruff-vault.toml \
  --ignore-noqa --output-format concise . 2>&1) || fail=1
envs=$(find . -type f -name '.env*' ! -name '.env.example' \
  -not -path './.git/*' | head -20)
if [ -n "$fail" ] || [ -n "$envs" ]; then
  jq -n --arg ctx "$bad
$envs" '{decision:"deny",
    reason:"Línea base Vault incumplida.", additionalContext:$ctx}'
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
